binding_on: the O3 preregistration, which must incorporate this document verbatim before any O3 implementation or training
scope_note: This freezes ONE constraint, not the whole O3 protocol. Other O3 cells depend on the Stage-4 verdict and on the Environment-Demand Gate's own must-freeze checklist and remain unfrozen.

frozen_before.why_now: artifacts/c3_discovery/C3_STAGE3_ANCHOR_RESULTS.jsonl now contains 165 recorded best_team_response labels. Freezing the prohibition while those labels exist and are unused is the only ordering that makes it meaningful; freezing it after an O3 design would be a claim about intent rather than a constraint.

prohibition: O3 must not use best_team_response, counterfactual witness actions, winning-response labels, or any derivative of those labels as imitation targets, auxiliary objectives, reward-shaping terms, curriculum labels, policy-conditioning signals, or sampling priorities. O3 receives the natural G0 prefix to the frozen onset state, then learns exclusively from post-onset task reward. Counterfactual response labels are evaluation-only and must not influence O3 optimization.

why.the_failure_mode: Supervising O3 toward the counterfactual winners would produce response diversity by construction. A later behavioral-nonredundancy result would then measure our labels rather than the environment's demands -- the check would cash itself.
why.why_it_is_tempting_here: Unlike O1, we now hold 165 labelled winning responses in an artifact. That is a ready-made supervision target sitting one import away from the training code.
why.precedent: The O1 protocol prohibited role bonuses and DEFEND/RECOVER/ROTATE_HOME semantics; the frozen C3 contract carries 'no z-role reward labels'. This extends the same principle to response supervision specifically.

artifacts: any derived table of winning responses
off_limits_artifacts_and_fields.permitted_use: evaluation and reporting only, after O3 training has completed

indirect_leakage_also_prohibited: a bonus, penalty or advantage term keyed to whether O3's action matches the witness
oversampling, reweighting or prioritising onset states according to which witness won, or according to fork utility improvement
initialising, warm-starting or biasing O3 toward an observed winning macro
curriculum ordering derived from fork outcomes
conditioning O3's observation, latent or context vector on any counterfactual label
early stopping, checkpoint selection or hyperparameter choice informed by agreement with witness responses
filtering the training onset set by which response won, or by the size of the utility improvement
any statistic of the counterfactual labels entering the O3 loss, sampler, or model input

what_o3_may_use.onset_states: the frozen commitment-fork onset states, reached by natural G0 play
what_o3_may_use.prefix: the natural G0 prefix up to the onset
what_o3_may_use.note: Which states are onsets is a legal, preregistered context definition. WHICH RESPONSE WON at those states is the answer we are trying to make PPO rediscover independently, and is therefore withheld.

verification_required_before_o3_training.1_static_check: the O3 training entry point and its transitive imports must not read any artifact listed in off_limits_artifacts_and_fields; a launcher preflight must assert this and fail closed
verification_required_before_o3_training.2_config_check: no O3 config field may carry a counterfactual label, witness action, or fork-utility statistic
verification_required_before_o3_training.3_declaration: the O3 training report must record response_supervision_used = false alongside the sha256 of this document
verification_required_before_o3_training.enforcement_principle: consistent with the rest of this pipeline, the constraint is enforced in code rather than left to operator discipline

immutability: This prohibition may not be relaxed after any O3 training or demand-gate outcome is observed. A future protocol that deliberately uses response supervision is a different experiment, requires its own preregistration, and may not be compared against a repertoire trained under this one.
